units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 20:9">Targ. Lev. XX, 9</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 20:11">11</cite> (O. ed. Berl. <cite ref="S00917"><he>קַטְּ׳</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 24:11">Targ. Prov. XXIV, 11</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 11a:3-8">Snh. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>שמעון</he> … <he>לחרבא וחברוהי לק׳</he> Simon and Yishmael are destined to fall by the sword, and their colleagues to be executed.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:13">Ab. I, 13</cite> <he>ק׳ חייב</he> deserves death.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 73b:9">Snh. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>מסרה נפשה לק׳</he> she was prepared to die (resisting her assailant).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 78b:5">Ib. 78ᵇ</cite> <he>בר ק׳ הוא … קְטָלֵיה במאי</he> he was guilty of a capital crime, but Moses did not know in what manner he was to be executed.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 79b:5">Ib. 79ᵇ</cite> <he>אי בר ק׳ הוא וכ׳</he> if he is to be put to death &c.
